name: CNOT followed by CZ
summary: A CNOT followed by a CZ on the same qubits is a single CNOT surrounded by S and S† gates.
description:
A CNOT followed by a CZ on the same pair of qubits is equal, up to a global phase, to a single CNOT preceded by an S gate on the target and followed by $S^\dagger$ gates on both qubits. So a CZ following a CNOT on the same qubits can always be absorbed into the CNOT and single-qubit phase gates.

Rules of this kind are useful for reducing the two-qubit gate count of Clifford circuits.
